description: Pinned W3C vc-di-eddsa revision whose eddsa-jcs-2022 test vectors both SDKs are checked against (ADR-006 D-8d, WP-46). CI checks out the repository at `commit` and runs sdk/tests/VcDiEddsaTestVectors.test.ts and sdk-python/tests/test_vc_di_eddsa_vectors.py with VC_DI_EDDSA_DIR pointing at it. Pinned deliberately; update with a reason, never to make a run pass.

notApplicable.TestVectors/eddsa-rdfc-2022: RDF Dataset Canonicalization: the SDKs implement only the JCS cryptosuite.
notApplicable.TestVectors/proof-set-chain: Proof sets and chains: an AgentMetadataCredential carries exactly one proof.
